meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: 它会列出多个互相竞争的故障假设(覆盖逻辑、数据、状态等 6 类),按文件:行号收集证据并标注置信度,再仲裁出根因,最后用清单核对修复是否有效。
howto.when: 当一个 bug 存在多个可能原因、跨多个模块,或初次排查没找到问题时接管;也可用于系统化的根因分析。

say.text: 这个 bug 有好几个可能原因,帮我生成竞争假设并分头排查
say.note: 会并行调查并汇总证据

say.text: 我的报错跨了好几个模块,做一次系统化根因分析
say.note: 按 6 类失败模式生成假设

say.text: 帮我仲裁这些假设,给出根因和修复验证清单

howto.what_en: It generates competing failure hypotheses across six failure-mode categories, collects evidence with file:line citations and confidence levels, arbitrates a root cause, then checks the fix against a validation list.
howto.when_en: Use it when a bug has multiple plausible causes, spans multiple modules, or initial debugging attempts failed; it also fits systematic root cause analysis.

say_en.text: This bug has several possible causes - generate competing hypotheses and investigate in parallel
say_en.note: Investigations run in parallel and evidence is pooled

say_en.text: The error spans several modules; do a systematic root cause analysis
say_en.note: Hypotheses are generated across six categories

say_en.text: Arbitrate these hypotheses and give me the root cause plus a fix validation list
say_en.note: You get the root cause and validation items
